title: Zau Lien Wang

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 1421
Date 6/3/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

March 6th 1916

Sir,
General Han 韓 arrived here from Peking on 5th instant.
for the purpose of purchasing military equipment for the
Expeditionary Force against Yunnan. He is staying at the Arsenal.
Deputy Military Governor Lu 盧 yesterday visited the
Arsenal where he and General Yang discussed the dispatching
of more troops to Nanking. It is said that some of the
soldiers who are concentrated in Nanking will be sent to
Hupeh in the near future.
On 4th instant four machine guns and sixteen boxes of
ammunition were placed on board the s.s. Kiang Yoong a
C.M.S.Co's boat which has been chartered by the Government
and which left for Nanking yesterday.
It is said that the opium merchants in Shanghai have
received a telegram from the opium merchants in Hongkong
saying that the latter would be willing to give $3,000,000.00
to Yuan's war fund if the Chinese Government extends the
opium prohibition period by nine months.
Colonel Tsu Lien Wang 諸連旺 of General Yang's staff
who has been on a visit to Nanking for the past two days
returned on Friday 5th to the Arsenal where he reported that
the situation at Nanking is very grave. Business is at a
standstill and the people are in a state of unrest. Several
thousand northern troops who arrived recently at Pukow
and Sha Kwan 沙關 are said not to be behaving themselves
as well as they might. It is impossible to ascertain
whether General Feng intends to revolt or remain loyal.
A native of Pootung named Tung Kwo Liang 董國良 who is
alleged to be the leader of Loong Sau Taung 龍壽堂 secret society
at Bak Loong Kaung Pootung 白龍港浦東 was arrested by the Nanwei
police on 3rd instant. On the 4th instant he was sent to
the Arsenal where he is now detained.
There are still a number of famine sufferers moving
about in Pootung but they are at present confined to the
region of sea wall.

Your Obedient Servant,
mmmmmmustine
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
刑事偵緝處
I. O. REG
第 1421 號
日期 16年3月6日

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警務處）
警務處，
（偵探分部）

1916年3月6日

先生：

韓將軍於本月5日從北京抵達此地，目的是為征滇遠征軍購買軍事裝備。他目前住在兵工廠。

副督軍盧氏昨日訪問了兵工廠，他與楊將軍討論了向南京增派部隊的事宜。據稱，集中在南京的部分士兵不久後將被派往湖北。

本月4日，四挺機槍和十六箱彈藥被裝上「江永」輪（Kiang Yoong），這是一艘中國招商局（C.M.S.Co's）的輪船，已被政府包租，並於昨日啟程前往南京。

據稱，上海的鴉片商人收到來自香港鴉片商人的電報，稱如果中國政府將鴉片禁令期限延長九個月，後者願意向袁世凱的軍費基金捐贈3,000,000.00美元。

楊將軍參謀處的諸連旺（Tsu Lien Wang）上校在過去兩天訪問南京後，於5日（星期五）返回兵工廠，他報告說南京的局勢非常嚴峻。商業停滯，人心惶惶。據稱，最近抵達浦口和沙關（Sha Kwan）的數千名北方軍隊行為不端。目前無法確定馮將軍是意圖反叛還是保持忠誠。

一名名叫董國良（Tung Kwo Liang）的浦東人，據稱是浦東白龍港（Bak Loong Kaung Pootung）龍壽堂（Loong Sau Taung）秘密社團的首領，於本月3日被南威（Nanwei）警察逮捕。本月4日，他被送往兵工廠，目前被拘押在那裡。

浦東仍有許多災民在流動，但他們目前局限在海塘地區。

您順從的僕人，
mmmmmmustine
總偵探督察

警務處總監
